info.title: Rocento Merchant Application API
info.description: Authenticated preview of reviewed storefront, customer and merchant application endpoints. Access requires a current merchant administrator session and api.docs.read. Reading this reference grants no API execution privileges and no access to another merchant. Each provisioned merchant deployment uses its own database. Existing per-operation permissions still apply. Internal assistant, agent, infrastructure and service contracts remain private. A stable third-party integration API and self-service credentials are not yet released. This reference cannot execute requests or collect credentials.

get.description:
Read active, unexpired, non-withdrawn messages for the server-resolved recipient. Initializes a server-minted HttpOnly inbox_guest cookie for anonymous visitors. Guest announcements contain no customer journey content. Read state is per recipient; signing in never merges guest history. No-store response. A supplied invalid bearer fails authentication; it never falls back to a guest. Customer ownership is derived from the session, never request data.

The server resolves the recipient from a valid customer bearer or a server-issued HttpOnly inbox_guest cookie. Invalid supplied bearer credentials fail; they never fall back to a guest. GET /v1/notifications initializes the guest cookie. Read mutations require an existing session. Guest history stays in that browser and does not merge on sign-in. Responses are private and no-store.

area_ids.description: Active delivery area IDs. Empty or omitted means all locations. Targeted announcements require a matching selected delivery pin; unknown locations never match.

trigger_product_id.description: An active product UUID. When set, deliver once per recipient after a product-view event during the campaign window. Null or omitted keeps broadcast behavior.

cta_path.description: Supported relative storefront path only: /, /search, /cart, /support, /account, /account/orders, /products/{slug}, /categories/{slug}, /pages/{slug}, or /account/orders/{uuid}. No query, fragment, encoded characters, traversal or external destination. Supply together with cta_label or set both to null.

starts_at.description: Null publishes now. Otherwise between five minutes ago and 90 days ahead.

expires_at.description: After now and starts_at, at most 90 days after the effective start.

delay_minutes.description: Minimum elapsed minutes after the matching event before delivery is eligible. Must be zero without a trigger.

lookback_days.description: Use the latest matching event within this many days, no earlier than the campaign publication start.

cooldown_hours.description: Minimum elapsed hours between deliveries to the same recipient. Repeated delivery requires at least one hour.

max_deliveries.description: Maximum deliveries per recipient. Each repeat also requires a distinct matching event; repeated polling never counts as an event.

NotificationAudienceRules.description: Structured automatic campaign eligibility evaluated by the isolated engagement worker. Segments and customer/order conditions require the customers audience; guests and everyone can use visit and product_view events only. Rules use the existing bounded condition language. A null trigger selects the audience without an event and requires max_deliveries=1. Repeated event delivery requires cooldown_hours>=1. Segment membership and customer facts are resolved by the server, never supplied by the storefront. Missing facts fail closed. trigger_product_id requires a product_view rule. Everyone/guest visit rules allow one delivery only. Purchase suppression requires a customers audience and an event. These cross-field rules are validated by the server before saving or publishing.

NotificationCampaignInput.description: A persistent draft of a native inbox campaign. Creation requires version=0; updates require the current saved version. Saving does not publish or deliver. Expiry is required and validated against the effective start (now when starts_at is null); activation revalidates the window. A published campaign cannot be edited.

value.description: Typed value encoded as text. verified: true/false with eq; order_count/account_age_days: whole number 0–1000000000 with eq/gte/lte; product.name: case-insensitive eq/contains; order.status: supported recorded workflow state with eq/neq; order.total: exact nonnegative decimal, at most two decimal places and 999999999999.99, with eq/gte/lte; order.currency: uppercase three-letter code with eq. Unknown operators, malformed values, and fields unavailable for the selected trigger are rejected.

currency.description: Required only for order.total and forbidden for other fields. A different event currency never matches.

NotificationConditions.description: A bounded, non-nested eligibility group. All applies AND; any applies OR. An empty all group adds no restrictions; an empty any group is invalid. Conditions evaluate the same latest trigger event as personalization, never an older event selected to make the conditions pass. Missing values never match, including neq. Current customer facts come from the server. No expressions or SQL are accepted.

idempotency_key.description: A non-nil UUID. Scoped to this program and permanently bound to this customer and program version. Reuse for an exact retry; use a new key for a new request.

NotificationProgramInput.description: A plain-text notification definition using only allowlisted {{token}} placeholders returned by metadata. Activation permits manual generation; it does not schedule background processing or deliver to any channel. Channel is recorded as future delivery intent. Title and body each allow at most 40 exact placeholders; internal whitespace, unknown tokens, unbalanced braces and recursive expressions are rejected. Names and titles are single-line; description and body permit newlines and tabs. Archived programs cannot return to another status. Omitted conditions on legacy programs default to an empty all group; no migration is required.
